prompt:
The attached image is the official corporate mascot 'Fujie' of Fujikin, a Japanese ultra-precision valve manufacturer. It is a STURGEON rendered in polished stainless steel. Design a CUTE DEFORMED (chibi / SD) mascot version of this exact character for use as a Japanese LINE sticker character and plush toy.

MUST KEEP these identifying features so it is unmistakably the same character:
- Body made of polished mirror-like stainless steel / chrome silver with soft blue-grey reflections
- Long flat pointed snout (rostrum) extending forward from the face
- A row of pointed bony scute plates running along the top of the back
- Four small barbel whiskers hanging under the snout
- One large round glossy black eye with a bright white catchlight
- Crescent shark-like tail fin

CUTE REDESIGN RULES:
- Big head, small rounded chubby body, short stubby pectoral fins used like little arms
- Soft rounded silhouette, huggable, no sharp or scary edges, friendly closed smiling mouth
- Clean modern Japanese mascot illustration style, bold confident dark outline, flat cel shading with a few crisp specular highlights to read as metal
- Pure white background, full body, centered, no text, no logo, no watermark

STYLE A: Maximum roundness and softness - almost like a silver mochi or dumpling with fins. Very short snout, very big eye, tiny fins. Reads as an adorable plush toy first, fish second.
